en: I drank coffee in the morning.
I didn't drink milk yesterday.
Why did you drink all this milk?

ar: ما شربتيش حتى كاس ديال الما
en: You didn't drink even a glass of water.

ar: شربتي عصير ديال الليمون مع صاحبتك
en: You (f.) drank lemon juice with your friend.
You (f.) didn't drink coffee with Mom.
My brother drank tea without sugar.
Dad didn't drink coffee today.
Mom drank water with lemon.
My sister didn't drink the milk today.
We drank tea at my grandfather's house.
We didn't drink anything at the café.
You (pl.) drank all my juice.
You (pl.) didn't drink the morning milk.
The kids drank milk before school.
Our neighbors didn't drink tea with us.

lat: kanchreb bezzaf dyal l-ma f s-sif
en: I drink a lot of water in summer.
I don't drink coffee at night.
What do you drink in the morning?

lat: ma katchrebch l-ma bezzaf f n-nhar
en: You don't drink much water during the day.

ar: كتشربي الشاي مع ماما كل عشية
en: You (f.) drink tea with Mom every evening.

lat: ma katcherbich l-7lib ila kan bard
ar: ما كتشربيش الحليب ايلا كان بارد
en: You (f.) don't drink milk if it's cold.
My brother drinks milk every morning.

lat: jeddi ma kaychrebch ch-chay bla n-n3na3
ar: جدي ما كيشربش الشاي بلا النعناع
en: My grandfather doesn't drink tea without mint.
Salma drinks coffee with milk.
Mom doesn't drink cold water.

lat: kancherbu l-3asir f l-kafi kul jem3a
en: We drink juice at the café every Friday.
We don't drink much soda.
Do you (pl.) drink tea or coffee?

lat: ma katcherbuch l-qehwa f had l-waqt
en: You (pl.) don't drink coffee at this time.
Moroccans drink tea with mint.

lat: l-3mal ma kaycherbuch l-qehwa f l-khedma
en: The workers don't drink coffee at work.

ar: غادي نشرب شي حاجة باردة دابا
en: I'm going to drink something cold now.
I'm not going to drink coffee tonight.
Are you going to drink tea with me?

lat: ma ghadich tchreb l-ma mn had l-bir
ar: ما غاديش تشرب الما من هاد البير
en: You won't drink water from this well.

lat: ghadi tcherbi l-3asir m3a khtek ghda
ar: غادي تشربي العصير مع ختك غدا
en: You (f.) will drink juice with your sister tomorrow.
You (f.) are not going to drink my tea.

lat: khuya ghadi ychreb l-qehwa m3a sa7bu
ar: خويا غادي يشرب القهوة مع صاحبو
en: My brother will drink coffee with his friend.

lat: jari ma ghadich ychreb m3ana ghda
ar: جاري ما غاديش يشرب معانا غدا
en: My neighbor won't drink with us tomorrow.

lat: Salma ghadi tchreb l-3asir f dar sa7btha
ar: سلمى غادي تشرب العصير فدار صاحبتها
en: Salma will drink juice at her friend's house.

ar: ختي ما غاديش تشرب الشاي عندنا
en: My sister won't drink tea at our place.

lat: ghadi ncherbu l-qehwa mn ba3d l-ghda
ar: غادي نشربو القهوة من بعد الغدا
en: We're going to drink coffee after lunch.

lat: ma ghadich ncherbu f l-kafi dyal l-7ay
ar: ما غاديش نشربو فالكافي ديال الحي
en: We won't drink at the neighborhood café.

ar: واش غادي تشربو عصير ولا الما
en: Are you (pl.) going to drink juice or water?

lat: ma ghadich tcherbu l-gazuz f l-mdrasa
en: You (pl.) won't drink soda at school.

lat: d-diyaf ghadi ycherbu ch-chay f s-salon
en: The guests will drink tea in the living room.

lat: ma ghadich ycherbu l-ma mn had l-3in
ar: ما غاديش يشربو الما من هاد العين
en: They won't drink water from this spring.
